messages:
keisha: FYI I opened a compact PR that bundles migration steps, clear copy, and minimal SDK snippets for the new quota/rate headers. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/5230

arnav: Thanks. Can we keep examples intentionally tiny so they fit in emails/screenshots? Suggest: curl, python-sdk, node fetch. Also add one-liner note about proxies and header canonicalization.

keisha: Done. Curl: `curl -H 'x-rwd-quota-tier: platinum' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate` Python (recommended): `from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'))
client.request('/v1/generate', headers={'x-rwd-quota-tier': 'platinum'})` Node fetch: `await fetch(url, { headers: { 'x-rwd-quota-tier': 'platinum' } })`. Kept headers lowercase per proxy guidance.

harper: Small ask: add an explicit short PromQL example so customers can verify after switching headers. People always ask for that exact string.

keisha: Added a PromQL example and a plain-English line explaining it: `sum by (tier_label) (increase(billing.tier_assignments_total[14d]))` — "counts assignments per tier over the last 14 days; use to confirm traffic moved to the expected tiers after migration".

lin: Quick billing nuance: for Dedicated accounts we have a reserve-first model; dashboards show reserve consumption separately. I added a parenthetical: "Dedicated: reserve is applied before burst; check `billing.dedicated_reserve_usage` to see reserve consumption." Tagging eng to verify metric name.

arnav: Also include a short migration checklist at the top so customers don't miss steps. Example: 1) pin SDK >=0.9.2, 2) update headers, 3) smoke test against staging, 4) validate PromQL/dashboards.

keisha: Checklist and a yellow deprecation callout added. Also included a tiny example of common curl errors and a troubleshooting tip: "If you see unchanged tier counts, check proxies/load-balancers for header normalization and try lowercasing headers."

harper: Can you add one short example showing an old header -> new header mapping? People like quick diffs.

keisha: Added mapping table (inline): `X-Redwood-Tier` -> `x-rwd-quota-tier`, `X-Redwood-Rate` -> `x-rwd-rate`. Kept it compact.

lin: I pinged eng-runtime to confirm `billing.dedicated_reserve_usage` name. They replied that metric is `billing.dedicated_reserve_used`. I updated the text accordingly and added a link to the Dedicated metrics doc.

arnav: Docs-bot: can we get a deploy preview for the PR after that last change? Would like to sanity-check formatting.

docs-bot: Deploy preview available: https://deploy-preview-5230--docs.redwood.ai/rate-limits/migration-checklist (expires in 7 days).

qa-bot: Quick smoke results: curl + python snippets validated against staging. PromQL sample returned expected tier counts for our test traffic. Two minor nits: 1) add a one-line note about aggregation window (14d vs 7d) effect on spike interpretation, 2) update python snippet import comment to recommend `Client` usage in examples.

keisha: Addressed both QA nits: added sentence explaining 14d smooths short spikes vs 7d for quicker detection, and clarified python imports.

arnav: LGTM on staging. I'll approve once eng-runtime confirms nothing else. If green, merge and follow up with a tiny PR to add the final dashboard thumbnail later.

keisha: Thanks all — merging soon. After merge I'll open a follow-up to add a short Private/VPC note about header propagation in air-gapped setups.
